title: Canonical `O(3)` continuum limit and exact `O(4)` mass asymptotics

result.label: Canonical `O(3)` continuum limit and exact `O(4)` mass asymptotics
result.statement: Constructs the canonical continuum limit of the two-dimensional nearest-neighbor O(3) model: a non-Gaussian local relativistic theory with a unique vacuum and a positive mass gap. For the square-lattice O(4) model, determines the exact leading asymptotic of the full transfer gap, m lat ( ) 32e^ /4-1/2 ,e^ - . The family also proves exponential spin-correlation decay for two-dimensional nearest-neighbor O(n) models with n ≥ 3 at every positive temperature.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
